_readme: Route map for tools/l10n/device_sweep.py. Every hop names an ARB KEY, not a
coordinate: the driver resolves the key to the active locale's string, finds
that node in Flutter's semantics tree and taps whatever bounds the phone
reports. So this one file replays across all six locales and every density.
Deliberately NOT visited: settingsTellFriend and settingsNeedHelp leave the
app (system share sheet / mailto), and settingsLogout + settingsDeleteAccount
would end the session mid-sweep. The apply and share flows are premium-gated
actions with real side effects on the device, so they are left to the widget
matrix, which renders their sheets without performing them.

language_path/language_names drive the IN-APP picker. Android's per-app locale is ignored by this app (LocaleNotifier reads a persisted preference and defaults to English, never the platform locale), so the sweep must change the language the way a user does.
edit_name is NOT swept: the pencil that opens it is an icon with no text label, so there is no ARB key to aim at. The widget matrix covers settings.edit_name_sheet instead.
